notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.content:
Files are now sorted in alphabetical order
 Added file list view for the current folder. Press L or use the third icon to activate

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
On launch, the window will keep the last defined size
 Fixed error when setting zoom to 100% via the button
 Added zoom using the mouse wheel
 Added zoom levels (hold CTRL to activate higher zoom)

Interface adjustments
 Color adjustments
 Copy file fixed
 Added support for Ubuntu Linux
